```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
daily_sensor <- read_csv("daily_sensor_readings.csv")
scouting <- read_csv("scouting_observations.csv")

sensorscout <- scouting |> 
  mutate(
    blossom_norm = (blossom_count - min(blossom_count)) /
                    (max(blossom_count) - min(blossom_count)),

    notes_penalty = case_when(
      notes_flag == "None"  ~ 0.00,
      notes_flag == "Minor" ~ 0.10,
      notes_flag == "Major" ~ 0.25,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    leaf_penalty = case_when(
      leaf_color == "Good" ~ 0.00,
      leaf_color == "Fair" ~ 0.10,
      leaf_color == "Poor" ~ 0.25,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    risk_score =
      0.45 * disease_severity +
      0.35 * pest_severity +
      0.20 * blossom_norm +
      notes_penalty +
      leaf_penalty,

    risk_level = case_when(
      risk_score < 0.30 ~ "Low",
      risk_score < 0.60 ~ "Moderate",
      risk_score < 1.00 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ "Critical"
    )
  )



sensorscout

library(readr)
write_csv(
  sensorscout, "scouting_riskScore.csv", 
  na = "NA", 
)


```



```{r}
normalize <- function(x) {
  return ((x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
}

stress_recovery <- daily_sensor |> group_by(farm_id, greenhouse_id, plot_id) |> mutate(recovery = -mean(post_action_stress_delta_3d)) |> ungroup() |> mutate(recovery = normalize(recovery)) |> select(plot_id, greenhouse_id, farm_id, recovery)

stress_recovery <- unique(stress_recovery)
stress_recovery






```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

response_efficiency <- daily_sensor |>
  filter(alert_flag == 1) |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  summarise(
    total_alerts = n(),
    same_day_responses = sum(action_taken == 1 & action_delay_days == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    same_day_response_rate = same_day_responses / total_alerts,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


response_efficiency
```

```{r}

finance_summary <- read_csv("season_summary.csv")

finance_summary <- finance_summary |> mutate(marketable_yield = season_yield_kg_m2 * marketable_ratio) |> mutate(marketable_yield = normalize(marketable_yield))


finance_summary <- finance_summary |> mutate(roi_normalized = normalize(season_roi))

finance_summary <- finance_summary |> mutate(precision_benefit = precision_benefit_cad * total_cost_cad) |> mutate(precision_benefit = normalize(precision_benefit))

season_normalized <- finance_summary |> select(plot_id, marketable_yield, roi_normalized, precision_benefit)
season_normalized

sensor <- left_join(stress_recovery, response_efficiency, by = "plot_id") |> select(plot_id, recovery, same_day_response_rate)

final <- left_join(season_normalized, sensor, by = "plot_id")

final





score <- final |> mutate(score = .45 * marketable_yield + .25 * roi_normalized + .10 * recovery + .00 * same_day_response_rate + .20 * precision_benefit)
score
mean(score$score)
ggplot(score, aes(x=plot_id, y = score)) + geom_col()

score |> arrange(desc(score))

max(score$score)
min(score$score)

```

```{r}




plot_health <- daily_sensor |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  summarise(
    plot_health = mean(
      1 - (
        .33 * plant_stress_index +
        .33 * disease_risk_index +
        .33 * pest_pressure_index
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
max(daily_sensor$plot_health)
summary(daily_sensor$plot_health)

normalize <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
    (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

environment_stability <- daily_sensor |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  summarise(
    air_temp_sd = sd(air_temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    humidity_sd = sd(relative_humidity_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_sd = sd(vpd_kpa, na.rm = TRUE),
    moisture_sd = sd(substrate_moisture, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    air_temp_var_n = normalize(air_temp_sd),
    humidity_var_n = normalize(humidity_sd),
    vpd_var_n = normalize(vpd_sd),
    moisture_var_n = normalize(moisture_sd),

    env_variability =
      0.25 * air_temp_var_n +
      0.25 * humidity_var_n +
      0.25 * vpd_var_n +
      0.25 * moisture_var_n,

    env_stability_score = 1 - env_variability
  )

daily_sensor

plot_health
summary(plot_health)
max(plot_health$plot_health)
environment_stability

sensor_scores <- left_join(plot_health, environment_stability, by = "plot_id") 

sensor_scores <- sensor_scores |> select(plot_id, plot_health, env_stability_score)


sensor_scores
```





```{r}

score <- score |> select(plot_id, marketable_yield, roi_normalized,precision_benefit)


score <- left_join(score, sensor_scores)

score |> mutate(precision_benefit = normalize(precision_benefit))



score <- score |> mutate(final_score = .30 * marketable_yield + .25 * roi_normalized + .25 * plot_health + .15 * env_stability_score + .05 * precision_benefit)




score |> arrange(desc(marketable_yield)) |> ggplot(aes(x=plot_id, y = marketable_yield)) + geom_col()


score <- score |>
  mutate(
      final_score_scaled = final_score * (0.90 / max(final_score))
  )

summary(score$final_score_scaled)
```
